name: Affogato
tagline: Generate AI images, videos and audio from your agent.
description: Affogato provides a remote MCP server for AI image, video and audio generation, including speech, lipsync, talking heads, headshots, virtual try-on and product photography. Discover models, estimate credit costs, submit generations and check their status. Connect over Streamable HTTP and authorize an Affogato workspace using OAuth. Generations use paid workspace credits; new credit top-ups require an existing subscription. The linked public repository contains integration documentation and plugins; the hosted backend source is private.
license: Proprietary hosted service; public integration repository MIT

install.notes: Sign in with OAuth and select your Affogato workspace. Generations consume paid workspace credits. Setup: https://affogato.ai/mcp
